paracetamol.name: Paracetamol (Acetaminophen)
paracetamol.uses: Temporary relief of mild to moderate pain (headaches, muscle aches, toothaches) and reducing fever.
paracetamol.side_effects: Rare when taken at recommended doses. High doses can cause serious liver damage. Allergic reactions (rash, swelling) are very rare.
paracetamol.warnings: Do not exceed 4000 mg in 24 hours. Avoid alcohol. Check other cold/flu meds to prevent double-dosing.
paracetamol.storage: Store at room temperature away from direct heat and moisture.
paracetamol.interactions: Alcohol increases risk of liver toxicity. Warfarin (long-term use) may have increased bleeding risks.

aspirin.name: Aspirin (Acetylsalicylic Acid)
aspirin.uses: Pain relief, reducing inflammation, reducing fever, and preventing blood clots (low dose cardiovascular therapy).
aspirin.side_effects: Stomach upset, heartburn, easy bruising or bleeding, increased risk of stomach ulcers.
aspirin.warnings: Do not give to children or teenagers due to Reye's syndrome risk. Do not use if you have bleeding disorders or active stomach ulcers.
aspirin.storage: Store in a dry place at room temperature. Keep tightly closed.
aspirin.interactions: Interacts with blood thinners (Warfarin), NSAIDs (Ibuprofen), and corticosteroids.

ibuprofen.name: Ibuprofen
ibuprofen.uses: Relief of pain, inflammation, and stiffness caused by arthritis, menstrual cramps, headache, toothache, and back pain.
ibuprofen.side_effects: Nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, bloating, constipation, dizziness, high blood pressure.
ibuprofen.warnings: Take with food or milk to prevent stomach upset. Can increase risk of heart attack or stroke if used long-term or at high doses.
ibuprofen.storage: Store in a dry place at room temperature. Protect from light.
ibuprofen.interactions: Interacts with aspirin, blood pressure medications (ACE inhibitors like Lisinopril), and blood thinners.

metformin.name: Metformin
metformin.uses: Management of Type 2 diabetes to improve blood sugar control.
metformin.side_effects: Nausea, upset stomach, diarrhea, metallic taste in mouth. Rare but serious risk of lactic acidosis.
metformin.warnings: Do not use in patients with severe kidney disease. Avoid heavy alcohol intake while taking Metformin.
metformin.storage: Store at room temperature away from light and moisture.
metformin.interactions: Cimetidine, contrast dyes used for imaging (may require temporary suspension).

amoxicillin.name: Amoxicillin
amoxicillin.uses: Treatment of bacterial infections such as ear infections, strep throat, pneumonia, and urinary tract infections.
amoxicillin.side_effects: Diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, skin rash, yeast infection.
amoxicillin.warnings: Finish the entire prescribed course even if symptoms disappear. Do not use if you are allergic to penicillin.
amoxicillin.storage: Capsules: store at room temperature. Liquid: store in refrigerator (do not freeze) and discard after 14 days.
amoxicillin.interactions: May reduce the effectiveness of oral contraceptives. Allopurinol may increase risk of rash.
